summaries.title: Specialized Language Models with Cheap Inference from Limited Domain Data

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用稀疏专家路由与解耦表征设计。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Across these settings, we compare different approaches from the machine learning literature。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In particular, we show that hyper-networks and mixture of experts have better perplexity for large pretraining budgets, while small models trained on importance sampled datasets are...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 47 赞），本工作为突破 **混合专家与动态深度 (MoE/MoD)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In addition, we furthermore construct the APPS+ dataset for RL training, which is manually verified to ensure the correctness of unit tests。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experimental results show that our method improves the ability to explore the output space and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in corresponding benchmarks）。

summaries.title: TravelPlanner: A Benchmark for Real-World Planning with Language Agents
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **TravelPlanner** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、工具调用（Tool Use）。核心论点主张：To advance this investigation, we propose TravelPlanner, a new planning benchmark that focuses on travel planning, a common real-world planning scenario。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To advance this investigation, we propose TravelPlanner, a new planning benchmark that focuses on travel planning, a common real-world planning scenario。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **0.6%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Comprehensive evaluations show that the current language agents are not yet capable of handling such complex planning tasks-even GPT-4 only achieves a success rate of 0.6%）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 38 赞），本工作可作为评估 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Boximator: Generating Rich and Controllable Motions for Video Synthesis
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Boximator** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model），并引入 Boximator achieves state-of-the-art video quality (FVD) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We propose Boximator, a new approach for fine-grained motion control。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Boximator introduces two constraint types: hard box and soft box。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Empirically, Boximator achieves state-of-the-art video quality (FVD) scores, improving on two base models, and further enhanced after incorporating box constraints）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 27 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉生成与世界模型** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
